# ALS-S3-A2 receipt (Claude Code executor)

- task_id: ALS-S3-A2
- policy_version: 2026-09-02.1
- executor: Claude Code, Opus 5 (claude-opus-5)
- date: 2026-09-19
- status: files written; **no tests, scripts, or builds run by the executor** (the executor has only Read/Edit/Write). Codex runs verification.

## Changed files

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| scripts/render-ai-learning.mjs | New. Renders generated.json with the installed VitePress createMarkdownRenderer, expands the 8 textbook components, checks source HTML and output HTML against allowlists, and writes rendered.json atomically. Round 2: `v-pre` (with or without `=""`) is stripped only from `<pre>` in the renderer's output stage. |
| scripts/render-ai-learning.test.mjs | New. Round 2: adds a `v-pre` regression test (stripped from `<pre>` output; `v-pre`/`v-html` in source and `v-pre` on other output elements still rejected). |
| src/lib/ai-learning/catalog.ts | Existing selectors kept. Added getNeighborLessons, getLessonStatusLabel, getReviewLabel, and RenderedLesson/RenderedLearningData types (types only). |
| src/app/learning/page.tsx | New. Course map. |
| src/app/learning/[lesson]/page.tsx | New. Reading page, honest planned page, 404 for unknown IDs, previous/next with status. Imports rendered.json on the server. |
| src/app/learning/learning.css | New. Scoped `.ai-learning-*` styles; inherits theme text color; tables scroll on mobile. |
| package.json | Scripts only: content:ai, predev, prebuild, precheck. No dependency/lockfile changes. |
| shared/site-header.tsx | Added a 学习路线 link to desktop and mobile navigation. User's language-switch removal and all existing links kept. |
| README.md | Appended the "AI 学习站阅读页（/learning）" section. |

## Not verified / risks

1. The v-pre fix assumes VitePress emits `v-pre` or `v-pre=""` on `<pre>`, based on Codex's diagnosis; not observed by the executor.
2. Other VitePress output attributes not seen yet would fail the output allowlist loudly (never pass silently). Needs one real run.
3. Dark-mode colors not checked in a browser. Styles inherit currentColor, so they should follow the site's data-color-mode.
4. `npm run check` now runs content:ai twice (precheck, then prebuild inside build). Correct, but slower.
5. `PageProps<"/learning/[lesson]">` relies on Next 16 generated route types, which are produced during typegen/build.

## Human gates unchanged

Content draft, team access not_open. No publishing, no acceptance claimed. Quiz, progress, and scores are not connected.

剩下 6 项写完了 5 项，`v-pre` 的问题也修了；回执文件被拒写，内容放在下面。我没有跑任何测试、脚本或构建，全部等 Codex 复验。

回执写到 `work/ALS-S3-A2-receipt.md` 时 Write 被拒。这个路径是我自己猜的，合同只写了 “task receipt”，没给具体路径，所以我没换路径再试。需要落文件的话，请给出放行的精确路径。

## 本轮改动
| 文件 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `src/app/learning/[lesson]/page.tsx` | 新建，按原计划的内容用原 Write 写入成功，路径没变。四章显示完整正文和目录；待编写的课显示计划说明；课程地图以外的课号 404；上一课/下一课带状态标签；`rendered.json` 只在服务端引入。 |
| `scripts/render-ai-learning.mjs` | 只在渲染输出这一步去掉 `<pre>` 上的 `v-pre`，带不带 `=""` 都去掉。其他元素不处理，正文里手写的 `v-*` 属性仍按原白名单拒绝，其余 HTML 防护不变。 |
| `scripts/render-ai-learning.test.mjs` | 加 1 个回归测试：输出里不再有 `v-pre`；两种写法都能去掉；其他元素上的 `v-pre` 仍被输出白名单拦下；正文里的 `v-pre` 和 `v-html` 仍被拒绝。 |
| `src/app/learning/learning.css` | 新建。样式都限定在 `.ai-learning-*` 下，颜色跟随当前主题的文字颜色；阅读区最宽 46rem；手机上表格在自己框里横向滚动，不撑宽页面。 |
| `package.json` | 只改 scripts：加 `content:ai`、`predev`、`prebuild`、`precheck`。dependencies 和 lockfile 没动。 |
| `site-header.tsx` | 桌面和手机菜单各加一个“学习路线”链接。你删掉语言切换的改动和原有链接都保留。 |
| `README.md` | 文末追加 `/learning` 一节：母源在哪、本机依赖和可覆盖的环境变量、命令、draft / not_open 状态、测验和进度尚未接入。 |

## 请 Codex 复验
- `node --test scripts/generate-ai-learning.test.mjs scripts/render-ai-learning.test.mjs`
- `npm run check`
- 浏览器看 `/learning`、`/learning/l01`、一个待编写的课、一个不存在的课号

## 未验证的风险
1. 这次修复假设 VitePress 只会输出 `v-pre` 或 `v-pre=""` 两种写法，依据是 Codex 的诊断，我没有亲眼看到实际输出。如果还有别的没见过的属性，会被白名单直接报错，不会悄悄放行，但需要跑一次才知道。
2. 深色模式下的颜色没有在浏览器里看过。
3. `npm run check` 现在会生成两次数据（`precheck` 一次，build 前的 `prebuild` 又一次），结果没问题，只是慢一些。
4. `PageProps<"/learning/[lesson]">` 类型要靠 Next 16 在构建时自动生成的路由类型。

人工闸门没变：内容仍是草稿，未向团队开放，没有发布，也不代表已验收。
